# ==============================================================================
# Prepare AURORA longitudinal cfDNA inputs for MOFA2/MEFISTO
# ==============================================================================
# Inputs:
#   1. Longitudinal gene-by-sample CNV state matrix
#   2. Griffin_30TF_GC_corrected_summary_by_module.xlsx
#   3. Metasheet_Analysis.with_Histology_Receptor_status.Earliest_Met_Diagnosis.xlsx
#   4. AUP_ClinicalData_20260609.xlsx
#
# Primary output:
#   MEFISTO_long_residualized_primary.tsv
#       TFx/technical-adjusted Griffin features + tumor/fragmentation features +
#       gene-level CNV states for the 29 biological TFs profiled by Griffin.
#
# Sensitivity outputs:
#   MEFISTO_long_raw_Griffin_sensitivity.tsv
#   MEFISTO_long_technical_adjusted_sensitivity.tsv
#
# CNV design:
#   CNV states are encoded as HOMD=-2, HETD=-1, NEUT=0, GAIN=1, AMP=2,
#   HLAMP=3. The CNV view is restricted a priori to the 29 biological TF genes
#   used for Griffin nucleosome profiling. CTCF is excluded because it is used
#   as a technical-control factor. Individual TF genes are retained as directly
#   interpretable MEFISTO features; no genome-wide entropy ranking or CNV-pattern
#   collapsing is performed. Genes with inadequate coverage or zero variation
#   in the discovery cohort are reported and excluded from model input.
# ==============================================================================

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

MIN_DRAWS_PER_PATIENT <- 3L
MIN_COMPLETE_SAMPLES_FOR_RESIDUALIZATION <- 30L
MIN_COMPLETE_PATIENTS_FOR_RESIDUALIZATION <- 10L

# Griffin TFBS genes used as the biologically targeted CNV feature set.

GRIFFIN_BIOLOGICAL_TFBS_GENES <- c(

  "XBP1", "FOXM1", "FOXO3", "RUNX2", "SMAD1", "SMAD3", "SMAD4", "JUN",
  "NFATC1", "SPI1", "RELA", "MYC", "TP53"
)
GRIFFIN_TECHNICAL_TFBS_GENES <- c("CTCF")
GRIFFIN_TFBS_GENES <- c(
  GRIFFIN_BIOLOGICAL_TFBS_GENES,
  GRIFFIN_TECHNICAL_TFBS_GENES
)
CNV_TARGET_GENES <- GRIFFIN_BIOLOGICAL_TFBS_GENES

if (anyDuplicated(GRIFFIN_TFBS_GENES) ||
    length(intersect(GRIFFIN_BIOLOGICAL_TFBS_GENES,
                     GRIFFIN_TECHNICAL_TFBS_GENES)) > 0L) {
  stop("Biological and technical Griffin TFBS gene lists must be unique and non-overlapping.")
}
if (length(CNV_TARGET_GENES) != 29L) {
  warning(
    "The current CNV target list contains ", length(CNV_TARGET_GENES),
    " genes rather than the original 29. This is allowed for future expansion."
  )
}

# Targeted CNV QC. Do not apply the previous genome-wide altered-patient or
# entropy ranking filters. A target gene is retained when it is sufficiently
# observed, altered in at least one patient, and variable across blood draws.
CNV_MIN_NONMISSING_FRACTION <- 0.80
CNV_MIN_ALTERED_PATIENTS <- 1L

CNV_STATE_MAP <- c(
  HOMD = -2,
  HETD = -1,
  LOSS = -1,
  DEL = -1,
  NEUT = 0,
  NEUTRAL = 0,
  GAIN = 1,
  AMP = 2,
  HLAMP = 3
)

# ------------------------------- Helpers --------------------------------------
normalize_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[is.na(x) | x %chin% c("", "NA", "NaN")] <- NA_character_
  sub("^AUP-", "", x)
}

normalize_er <- function(x) {
  z <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  out <- rep("Unknown", length(z))
  out[z %chin% c("positive", "pos", "+", "er+", "1")] <- "Positive"
  out[z %chin% c("negative", "neg", "-", "er-", "0")] <- "Negative"
  out
}

numeric_safe <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

z_safe <- function(x) {
  s <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(s) || s == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  as.numeric((x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / s)
}

# Read a Griffin sheet with two header rows. Row 2 contains full feature names.
read_griffin_sheet <- function(path, sheet) {
  raw <- as.data.table(read_excel(path, sheet = sheet, col_names = FALSE))
  if (nrow(raw) < 3L || ncol(raw) < 2L) stop("Unexpected Griffin sheet: ", sheet)

  headers <- as.character(unlist(raw[2L, ], use.names = FALSE))
  headers[1L] <- "sample"
  if (anyNA(headers[-1L]) || any(headers[-1L] == "")) {
    stop("Missing feature name in row 2 of Griffin sheet: ", sheet)
  }
  if (anyDuplicated(headers)) stop("Duplicated columns in Griffin sheet: ", sheet)

  dt <- copy(raw[-c(1L, 2L)])
  setnames(dt, headers)
  dt[, sample := normalize_sample(sample)]
  dt <- dt[!is.na(sample)]

  feature_cols <- setdiff(names(dt), "sample")
  dt[, (feature_cols) := lapply(.SD, numeric_safe), .SDcols = feature_cols]
  if (anyDuplicated(dt$sample)) stop("Duplicated samples in Griffin sheet: ", sheet)
  dt
}

# Read the longitudinal CNV matrix. The expected orientation is genes in rows
# and blood-draw samples in columns. Non-sample annotation columns are ignored
# later by matching column names to the molecular sample IDs.
read_cnv_matrix <- function(path) {
  x <- fread(path, check.names = FALSE, data.table = TRUE)
  if (nrow(x) == 0L || ncol(x) < 2L) stop("CNV matrix is empty or malformed: ", path)

  gene_candidates <- c("gene", "Gene", "GENE", "HUGO_SYMBOL", "Hugo_Symbol", "symbol")
  gene_col <- intersect(gene_candidates, names(x))
  gene_col <- if (length(gene_col)) gene_col[1L] else names(x)[1L]
  setnames(x, gene_col, "gene")
  x[, gene := trimws(as.character(gene))]

  original_cols <- setdiff(names(x), "gene")
  normalized_cols <- normalize_sample(original_cols)
  valid <- !is.na(normalized_cols)
  if (anyDuplicated(normalized_cols[valid])) {
    dup <- unique(normalized_cols[valid][duplicated(normalized_cols[valid])])
    stop("Duplicated CNV sample columns after normalization: ", paste(dup, collapse = ", "))
  }
  setnames(x, original_cols[valid], normalized_cols[valid])
  x
}

prepare_cnv_tfbs_genes <- function(cnv, discovery, outdir) {
  sample_cols <- intersect(discovery$sample, names(cnv))
  missing_cnv <- setdiff(discovery$sample, sample_cols)

  fwrite(
    data.table(
      sample = discovery$sample,
      group = discovery$patient_id,
      CNV_available = discovery$sample %chin% sample_cols
    ),
    file.path(outdir, "CNV_sample_matching_QC.tsv"),
    sep = "\t"
  )

  if (length(missing_cnv)) {
    fwrite(
      data.table(sample = missing_cnv),
      file.path(outdir, "WARNING_discovery_samples_missing_CNV.tsv"),
      sep = "\t"
    )
  }

  if (length(sample_cols) < 10L) {
    stop("Too few discovery samples match the CNV matrix: ", length(sample_cols))
  }

  # Match target genes case-insensitively while retaining approved symbols.
  cnv_work <- copy(cnv)
  cnv_work[, gene := toupper(trimws(as.character(gene)))]
  cnv_work <- cnv_work[
    !(is.na(gene) | gene %chin% c("", "-", ".", "NA")),
    c("gene", sample_cols),
    with = FALSE
  ]

  target_rows <- cnv_work[gene %chin% CNV_TARGET_GENES]
  target_presence <- data.table(
    gene = CNV_TARGET_GENES,
    requested_order = seq_along(CNV_TARGET_GENES)
  )
  target_counts <- target_rows[, .(n_rows_in_CNV_matrix = .N), by = gene]
  target_presence <- merge(target_presence, target_counts, by = "gene", all.x = TRUE)
  target_presence[is.na(n_rows_in_CNV_matrix), n_rows_in_CNV_matrix := 0L]
  target_presence[, present_in_CNV_matrix := n_rows_in_CNV_matrix > 0L]
  setorder(target_presence, requested_order)

  missing_target_genes <- target_presence[present_in_CNV_matrix == FALSE, gene]
  if (length(missing_target_genes)) {
    fwrite(
      data.table(gene = missing_target_genes),
      file.path(outdir, "WARNING_requested_TFBS_genes_missing_CNV.tsv"),
      sep = "\t"
    )
  }

  if (nrow(target_rows) == 0L) {
    stop("None of the requested Griffin biological TF genes were found in the CNV matrix.")
  }

  state_text <- as.matrix(target_rows[, ..sample_cols])
  state_text[] <- trimws(toupper(state_text))
  state_text[state_text %in% c("", "NA", "NAN", ".")] <- NA_character_

  observed_states <- sort(unique(as.vector(state_text)))
  observed_states <- observed_states[!is.na(observed_states) & observed_states != ""]

  numeric_direct <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(state_text))
  numeric_fraction <- mean(!is.na(numeric_direct))
  if (is.finite(numeric_fraction) && numeric_fraction > 0.95) {
    state_mat_rows <- matrix(
      numeric_direct,
      nrow = nrow(state_text),
      ncol = ncol(state_text)
    )
  } else {
    unknown_states <- setdiff(observed_states, names(CNV_STATE_MAP))
    if (length(unknown_states)) {
      fwrite(
        data.table(unrecognized_state = unknown_states),
        file.path(outdir, "WARNING_unrecognized_CNV_states.tsv"),
        sep = "\t"
      )
      stop(
        "Unrecognized CNV state labels were found. Review ",
        "WARNING_unrecognized_CNV_states.tsv before continuing."
      )
    }

    mapped <- unname(CNV_STATE_MAP[state_text])
    state_mat_rows <- matrix(
      as.numeric(mapped),
      nrow = nrow(state_text),
      ncol = ncol(state_text)
    )
  }

  rownames(state_mat_rows) <- target_rows$gene
  colnames(state_mat_rows) <- sample_cols

  # Duplicate target-gene rows are allowed only when they do not conflict.
  # Non-conflicting duplicates are collapsed to one row using the available call.
  gene_indices <- split(seq_len(nrow(state_mat_rows)), target_rows$gene)
  duplicate_qc <- rbindlist(lapply(names(gene_indices), function(g) {
    idx <- gene_indices[[g]]
    conflicts <- if (length(idx) == 1L) {
      0L
    } else {
      sum(vapply(seq_along(sample_cols), function(j) {
        length(unique(na.omit(state_mat_rows[idx, j]))) > 1L
      }, logical(1)))
    }
    data.table(
      gene = g,
      n_rows_in_CNV_matrix = length(idx),
      n_conflicting_samples = conflicts
    )
  }))

  fwrite(
    duplicate_qc,
    file.path(outdir, "CNV_TFBS_duplicate_row_QC.tsv"),
    sep = "\t"
  )

  conflicting_genes <- duplicate_qc[n_conflicting_samples > 0L, gene]
  if (length(conflicting_genes)) {
    stop(
      "Conflicting duplicate CNV rows were found for target genes: ",
      paste(conflicting_genes, collapse = ", "),
      ". Review CNV_TFBS_duplicate_row_QC.tsv."
    )
  }

  collapse_one_gene <- function(idx) {
    if (length(idx) == 1L) return(state_mat_rows[idx, ])
    vapply(seq_along(sample_cols), function(j) {
      values <- unique(na.omit(state_mat_rows[idx, j]))
      if (length(values)) values[1L] else NA_real_
    }, numeric(1))
  }

  state_mat <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(CNV_TARGET_GENES[CNV_TARGET_GENES %chin% names(gene_indices)], function(g) {
      collapse_one_gene(gene_indices[[g]])
    })
  )
  rownames(state_mat) <- CNV_TARGET_GENES[CNV_TARGET_GENES %chin% names(gene_indices)]
  colnames(state_mat) <- sample_cols

  state_frequency <- as.data.table(table(
    state = as.vector(state_mat),
    useNA = "ifany"
  ))
  setnames(state_frequency, "N", "count")
  fwrite(
    state_frequency,
    file.path(outdir, "CNV_TFBS_state_frequency.tsv"),
    sep = "\t"
  )

  nonmissing_fraction <- rowMeans(!is.na(state_mat))
  altered_sample_fraction <- rowMeans(state_mat != 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  state_variance <- apply(state_mat, 1L, var, na.rm = TRUE)

  sample_to_patient <- discovery$patient_id[match(sample_cols, discovery$sample)]
  patient_indices <- split(seq_along(sample_cols), sample_to_patient)
  altered_by_patient <- do.call(cbind, lapply(patient_indices, function(idx) {
    rowSums(state_mat[, idx, drop = FALSE] != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  }))
  if (is.null(dim(altered_by_patient))) {
    altered_by_patient <- matrix(
      altered_by_patient,
      nrow = nrow(state_mat),
      dimnames = list(rownames(state_mat), names(patient_indices))
    )
  }

  altered_patient_count <- rowSums(altered_by_patient)
  altered_patient_fraction <- altered_patient_count / length(patient_indices)

  selected_gene_qc <- data.table(
    gene = rownames(state_mat),
    feature = paste0("CNV_", rownames(state_mat)),
    nonmissing_fraction = nonmissing_fraction,
    altered_sample_fraction = altered_sample_fraction,
    altered_patient_count = altered_patient_count,
    altered_patient_fraction = altered_patient_fraction,
    variance = state_variance
  )

  selected_gene_qc[, keep :=
    nonmissing_fraction >= CNV_MIN_NONMISSING_FRACTION &
    altered_patient_count >= CNV_MIN_ALTERED_PATIENTS &
    is.finite(variance) & variance > 0
  ]

  selected_gene_qc[, exclusion_reason := fifelse(
    keep,
    "",
    fifelse(
      nonmissing_fraction < CNV_MIN_NONMISSING_FRACTION,
      "nonmissing_fraction_below_threshold",
      fifelse(
        altered_patient_count < CNV_MIN_ALTERED_PATIENTS,
        "not_altered_in_any_discovery_patient",
        "zero_or_nonfinite_variance"
      )
    )
  )]

  gene_qc <- merge(
    target_presence,
    selected_gene_qc,
    by = "gene",
    all.x = TRUE
  )
  gene_qc[is.na(keep), `:=`(
    feature = paste0("CNV_", gene),
    keep = FALSE,
    exclusion_reason = "absent_from_CNV_matrix"
  )]
  setorder(gene_qc, requested_order)

  fwrite(
    gene_qc,
    file.path(outdir, "CNV_TFBS_gene_QC.tsv"),
    sep = "\t"
  )

  excluded <- gene_qc[keep == FALSE]
  if (nrow(excluded)) {
    fwrite(
      excluded,
      file.path(outdir, "CNV_TFBS_genes_excluded_after_QC.tsv"),
      sep = "\t"
    )
  }

  keep_genes <- selected_gene_qc[keep == TRUE, gene]
  if (!length(keep_genes)) {
    stop(
      "None of the requested TFBS CNV genes passed targeted QC. ",
      "Review CNV_TFBS_gene_QC.tsv."
    )
  }

  selected_mat <- state_mat[keep_genes, , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(selected_mat) <- paste0("CNV_", keep_genes)

  selected_mapping <- selected_gene_qc[
    keep == TRUE,
    .(
      gene,
      feature,
      nonmissing_fraction,
      altered_sample_fraction,
      altered_patient_count,
      altered_patient_fraction,
      variance
    )
  ]
  selected_mapping[, requested_order := match(gene, CNV_TARGET_GENES)]
  setorder(selected_mapping, requested_order)
  selected_mapping[, requested_order := NULL]

  fwrite(
    selected_mapping,
    file.path(outdir, "CNV_selected_TFBS_gene_mapping.tsv"),
    sep = "\t"
  )

  selected_wide <- as.data.table(selected_mat, keep.rownames = "feature")
  fwrite(
    selected_wide,
    file.path(outdir, "CNV_selected_TFBS_gene_matrix.tsv"),
    sep = "\t"
  )

  cnv_long <- as.data.table(as.table(selected_mat))
  setnames(cnv_long, c("feature", "sample", "value"))
  cnv_long[, `:=`(
    feature = as.character(feature),
    sample = as.character(sample),
    value = as.numeric(value)
  )]
  cnv_long <- cnv_long[is.finite(value)]
  cnv_long[, group := discovery$patient_id[match(sample, discovery$sample)]]
  cnv_long[, view := "CNV_TFBS_Genes"]
  setcolorder(cnv_long, c("sample", "group", "view", "feature", "value"))
  setorder(cnv_long, group, sample, feature)

  fwrite(
    cnv_long,
    file.path(outdir, "MEFISTO_long_CNV_TFBS_genes.tsv"),
    sep = "\t"
  )

  list(
    long = cnv_long,
    available_samples = sample_cols,
    missing_samples = missing_cnv,
    n_requested_genes = length(CNV_TARGET_GENES),
    n_found_genes = sum(target_presence$present_in_CNV_matrix),
    n_selected_genes = length(keep_genes),
    selected_genes = keep_genes
  )
}

# Residualize one Griffin feature. We remove only fixed technical effects.
# Patient random intercept is retained in the adjusted value, preserving stable
# patient-level biological differences.
residualize_one <- function(data, feature, include_tfx = TRUE) {
  metric <- sub("^[^_]+_", "", feature)
  ctcf_feature <- paste0("CTCF_", metric)

  required <- c(feature, "Mean_coverage", ctcf_feature, "patient_id")
  if (include_tfx) required <- c(required, "Tumor_Fraction")
  missing_required <- setdiff(required, names(data))
  if (length(missing_required)) {
    return(list(
      adjusted = rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)),
      diagnostic = data.table(
        feature = feature,
        CTCF_feature = ctcf_feature,
        include_TFx = include_tfx,
        n_complete = 0L,
        n_patients = 0L,
        method = "missing_columns",
        singular = NA,
        message = paste(missing_required, collapse = ";")
      )
    ))
  }

  tmp <- data.table(
    row_id = seq_len(nrow(data)),
    y = numeric_safe(data[[feature]]),
    tfx = numeric_safe(data[["Tumor_Fraction"]]),
    depth = numeric_safe(data[["Mean_coverage"]]),
    ctcf = numeric_safe(data[[ctcf_feature]]),
    patient = factor(data[["patient_id"]])
  )

  needed <- c("y", "depth", "ctcf", "patient")
  if (include_tfx) needed <- c(needed, "tfx")
  keep <- complete.cases(tmp[, ..needed])
  work <- tmp[keep]

  adjusted <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(data))
  n_complete <- nrow(work)
  n_patients <- uniqueN(work$patient)

  if (n_complete < MIN_COMPLETE_SAMPLES_FOR_RESIDUALIZATION ||
      n_patients < MIN_COMPLETE_PATIENTS_FOR_RESIDUALIZATION) {
    return(list(
      adjusted = adjusted,
      diagnostic = data.table(
        feature = feature,
        CTCF_feature = ctcf_feature,
        include_TFx = include_tfx,
        n_complete = n_complete,
        n_patients = n_patients,
        method = "insufficient_data",
        singular = NA,
        message = ""
      )
    ))
  }

  work[, depth_z := z_safe(depth)]
  work[, ctcf_z := z_safe(ctcf)]
  if (include_tfx) work[, tfx_z := z_safe(tfx)]

  predictor_cols <- c("depth_z", "ctcf_z")
  if (include_tfx) predictor_cols <- c("tfx_z", predictor_cols)

  if (any(!complete.cases(work[, ..predictor_cols]))) {
    return(list(
      adjusted = adjusted,
      diagnostic = data.table(
        feature = feature,
        CTCF_feature = ctcf_feature,
        include_TFx = include_tfx,
        n_complete = n_complete,
        n_patients = n_patients,
        method = "zero_variance_covariate",
        singular = NA,
        message = ""
      )
    ))
  }

  fixed_rhs <- paste(predictor_cols, collapse = " + ")
  mixed_formula <- as.formula(paste("y ~", fixed_rhs, "+ (1 | patient)"))

  fit <- suppressWarnings(tryCatch(
    lme4::lmer(
      mixed_formula,
      data = work,
      REML = TRUE,
      control = lme4::lmerControl(
        optimizer = "bobyqa",
        check.conv.singular = "ignore"
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  ))

  method <- "lmer"
  singular <- NA
  message_text <- ""

  if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
    # Safe fallback if a particular feature cannot support a mixed model.
    lm_formula <- as.formula(paste("y ~", fixed_rhs))
    fit_lm <- tryCatch(stats::lm(lm_formula, data = work), error = function(e) e)
    if (inherits(fit_lm, "error")) {
      return(list(
        adjusted = adjusted,
        diagnostic = data.table(
          feature = feature,
          CTCF_feature = ctcf_feature,
          include_TFx = include_tfx,
          n_complete = n_complete,
          n_patients = n_patients,
          method = "failed",
          singular = NA,
          message = paste(conditionMessage(fit), conditionMessage(fit_lm), sep = " | ")
        )
      ))
    }
    fixed_fitted <- stats::predict(fit_lm, newdata = work)
    method <- "lm_fallback"
    message_text <- conditionMessage(fit)
  } else {
    fixed_fitted <- stats::predict(
      fit,
      newdata = work,
      re.form = NA,
      allow.new.levels = TRUE
    )
    singular <- lme4::isSingular(fit, tol = 1e-4)
    if (isTRUE(singular)) method <- "lmer_singular"
  }

  # Remove only fixed effects. Random patient deviations remain in the signal.
  adjusted[work$row_id] <- work$y - as.numeric(fixed_fitted)

  list(
    adjusted = adjusted,
    diagnostic = data.table(
      feature = feature,
      CTCF_feature = ctcf_feature,
      include_TFx = include_tfx,
      n_complete = n_complete,
      n_patients = n_patients,
      method = method,
      singular = singular,
      message = message_text
    )
  )
}

make_mefisto_long <- function(data, feature_map, griffin_mode, cnv_long = NULL) {
  id_cols <- c("sample", "patient_id")

  tumor <- melt(
    data,
    id.vars = id_cols,
    measure.vars = intersect(TUMOR_FRAGMENTATION_FEATURES, names(data)),
    variable.name = "feature",
    value.name = "value",
    variable.factor = FALSE,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  tumor[, view := "Tumor_Fragmentation"]

  if (griffin_mode == "raw") {
    measure_cols <- feature_map$feature
    griffin <- melt(
      data,
      id.vars = id_cols,
      measure.vars = measure_cols,
      variable.name = "feature",
      value.name = "value",
      variable.factor = FALSE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    suffix <- if (griffin_mode == "primary_tfx_adjusted") {
      "__adj_TFx_depth_CTCF"
    } else if (griffin_mode == "technical_adjusted") {
      "__adj_depth_CTCF"
    } else {
      stop("Unknown Griffin mode: ", griffin_mode)
    }

    measure_cols <- paste0(feature_map$feature, suffix)
    present <- measure_cols %chin% names(data)
    measure_cols <- measure_cols[present]

    griffin <- melt(
      data,
      id.vars = id_cols,
      measure.vars = measure_cols,
      variable.name = "adjusted_feature",
      value.name = "value",
      variable.factor = FALSE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    griffin[, feature := sub(paste0(suffix, "$"), "", adjusted_feature)]
    griffin[, adjusted_feature := NULL]
  }

  griffin <- merge(griffin, feature_map, by = "feature", all.x = TRUE)
  if (anyNA(griffin$view)) stop("Could not assign a Griffin view to some features.")

  components <- list(
    tumor[, .(sample, group = patient_id, view, feature, value)],
    griffin[, .(sample, group = patient_id, view, feature, value)]
  )
  if (!is.null(cnv_long) && nrow(cnv_long)) {
    components[[length(components) + 1L]] <- cnv_long[, .(sample, group, view, feature, value)]
  }
  out <- rbindlist(components, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

  out[, `:=`(
    sample = as.character(sample),
    group = as.character(group),
    view = as.character(view),
    feature = as.character(feature),
    value = numeric_safe(value)
  )]

  setorder(out, group, sample, view, feature)
  if (anyDuplicated(out[, .(sample, group, view, feature)])) {
    stop("Duplicated sample-group-view-feature rows in ", griffin_mode, " output.")
  }
  out
}

# ------------------------------ Load Griffin ----------------------------------
message("Reading Griffin workbook...")
all_sheets <- excel_sheets(GRIFFIN_FILE)
missing_views <- setdiff(c(BIOLOGICAL_VIEWS, TECHNICAL_VIEW), all_sheets)
if (length(missing_views)) stop("Missing Griffin sheets: ", paste(missing_views, collapse = ", "))

griffin_list <- lapply(c(BIOLOGICAL_VIEWS, TECHNICAL_VIEW), function(v) {
  x <- read_griffin_sheet(GRIFFIN_FILE, v)
  setkey(x, sample)
  x
})
names(griffin_list) <- c(BIOLOGICAL_VIEWS, TECHNICAL_VIEW)

sample_sets <- lapply(griffin_list, function(x) x$sample)
reference_samples <- sample_sets[[1L]]
for (nm in names(sample_sets)[-1L]) {
  if (!setequal(reference_samples, sample_sets[[nm]])) {
    stop("Griffin sample set differs in sheet: ", nm)
  }
}

griffin <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "sample", all = FALSE), griffin_list)
if (anyDuplicated(griffin$sample)) stop("Duplicated Griffin sample IDs after merge.")

feature_map <- rbindlist(lapply(BIOLOGICAL_VIEWS, function(v) {
  data.table(feature = setdiff(names(griffin_list[[v]]), "sample"), view = v)
}))
if (anyDuplicated(feature_map$feature)) stop("A Griffin feature occurs in multiple biological views.")

# ------------------------------- Load CNV --------------------------------------
message("Reading longitudinal CNV state matrix...")
cnv <- read_cnv_matrix(CNV_FILE)
cnv_candidate_samples <- setdiff(names(cnv), "gene")

# ------------------------- Load metasheet and clinical -------------------------
message("Reading molecular metasheet...")
meta <- as.data.table(read_excel(META_FILE, sheet = 1L))
if (!"Collaborator_sample_id" %chin% names(meta)) stop("Collaborator_sample_id is absent from metasheet.")
if (!"Patient_id" %chin% names(meta)) stop("Patient_id is absent from metasheet.")

meta[, sample := normalize_sample(Collaborator_sample_id)]
meta[, patient_id := as.character(Patient_id)]
if (anyDuplicated(meta$sample)) stop("Duplicated sample IDs in molecular metasheet.")

numeric_meta <- intersect(
  c("Mean_coverage", TUMOR_FRAGMENTATION_FEATURES),
  names(meta)
)
meta[, (numeric_meta) := lapply(.SD, numeric_safe), .SDcols = numeric_meta]

message("Reading clinical event table...")
clinical <- as.data.table(read_excel(CLINICAL_FILE, sheet = 1L))
required_clinical <- c(
  "patient_id", "Category", "Days_From_Primary_Diagnosis", "Barcode",
  "ER_Status", "Tissue_Site", "EndTrt_Days_From_Primary_Diagnosis",
  "Regimen", "Met_Therapy_Line"
)
missing_clinical <- setdiff(required_clinical, names(clinical))
if (length(missing_clinical)) stop("Missing clinical columns: ", paste(missing_clinical, collapse = ", "))

clinical[, patient_id := as.character(patient_id)]
clinical[, day := numeric_safe(Days_From_Primary_Diagnosis)]
clinical[, end_day := numeric_safe(EndTrt_Days_From_Primary_Diagnosis)]
clinical[, sample := normalize_sample(Barcode)]
clinical[, ER_norm := normalize_er(ER_Status)]

# --------------------------- Derive patient ER --------------------------------
message("Deriving primary and earliest known metastatic ER status...")
patient_er <- clinical[, {
  d <- .SD[order(day)]
  primary <- d[Category == "First_Primary" & ER_norm %chin% c("Positive", "Negative")]
  met_all <- d[Category == "Met_Diagnosis"]
  met_known <- met_all[ER_norm %chin% c("Positive", "Negative")][order(day)]

  primary_er <- if (nrow(primary)) primary$ER_norm[1L] else "Unknown"
  primary_er_day <- if (nrow(primary)) primary$day[1L] else NA_real_
  first_met_day <- if (nrow(met_all) && any(is.finite(met_all$day))) min(met_all$day, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
  earliest_met_er <- if (nrow(met_known)) met_known$ER_norm[1L] else "Unknown"
  earliest_met_er_day <- if (nrow(met_known)) met_known$day[1L] else NA_real_
  earliest_met_tissue <- if (nrow(met_known)) as.character(met_known$Tissue_Site[1L]) else NA_character_

  sequence_text <- if (nrow(met_known)) {
    paste(
      paste0(
        met_known$day, ":", met_known$ER_norm, ":",
        fifelse(is.na(met_known$Tissue_Site), "", as.character(met_known$Tissue_Site))
      ),
      collapse = "; "
    )
  } else ""

  list(
    primary_er = primary_er,
    primary_er_day = primary_er_day,
    first_met_day = first_met_day,
    earliest_met_er = earliest_met_er,
    earliest_met_er_day = earliest_met_er_day,
    earliest_met_tissue = earliest_met_tissue,
    n_met_records = nrow(met_all),
    n_known_met_er_records = nrow(met_known),
    met_er_changed = uniqueN(met_known$ER_norm) > 1L,
    met_er_sequence = sequence_text
  )
}, by = patient_id]

fwrite(patient_er, file.path(OUTDIR, "Patient_ER_derivation.tsv"), sep = "\t")

# --------------------------- Match blood draws --------------------------------
blood <- clinical[
  Category == "Blood_Draw" & !is.na(sample),
  .(sample, patient_id, draw_day = day)
]
if (anyDuplicated(blood$sample)) {
  duplicate_blood <- blood[duplicated(sample) | duplicated(sample, fromLast = TRUE)]
  fwrite(duplicate_blood, file.path(OUTDIR, "ERROR_duplicate_Blood_Draw_barcodes.tsv"), sep = "\t")
  stop("Duplicate clinical Blood_Draw barcodes detected; see ERROR file.")
}

# Sample overlap QC before the merge.
known_sample_ids <- unique(c(meta$sample, griffin$sample, blood$sample))
cnv_sample_ids <- intersect(cnv_candidate_samples, known_sample_ids)
qc_sample_sets <- rbindlist(list(
  data.table(source = "Metasheet", sample = meta$sample),
  data.table(source = "Griffin", sample = griffin$sample),
  data.table(source = "Clinical_Blood_Draw", sample = blood$sample),
  data.table(source = "CNV", sample = cnv_sample_ids)
))
qc_sample_sets[, present := TRUE]
qc_wide <- dcast(qc_sample_sets, sample ~ source, value.var = "present", fill = FALSE)
fwrite(qc_wide, file.path(OUTDIR, "Sample_matching_QC.tsv"), sep = "\t")

integrated <- merge(meta, griffin, by = "sample", all = FALSE)
integrated <- merge(integrated, blood, by = c("sample", "patient_id"), all.x = TRUE)
integrated <- merge(integrated, patient_er, by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)

if (anyDuplicated(integrated$sample)) stop("Duplicated molecular sample IDs after integration.")
unmatched_draws <- integrated[is.na(draw_day), .(sample, patient_id)]
if (nrow(unmatched_draws)) {
  fwrite(unmatched_draws, file.path(OUTDIR, "ERROR_samples_without_Blood_Draw.tsv"), sep = "\t")
  stop("Some molecular samples lack a matching Blood_Draw record; see ERROR file.")
}

setorder(integrated, patient_id, draw_day, sample)
integrated[, draw_order := seq_len(.N), by = patient_id]
integrated[, days_from_first_draw := draw_day - min(draw_day, na.rm = TRUE), by = patient_id]
integrated[, days_from_first_met := draw_day - first_met_day]
integrated[, days_from_earliest_known_met_er := draw_day - earliest_met_er_day]

# Draw-specific ER, treatment, and progression annotations.
message("Adding draw-specific clinical annotations...")
clinical_by_patient <- split(clinical[order(patient_id, day)], by = "patient_id", keep.by = TRUE)

draw_annotations <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(integrated)), function(i) {
  pid <- integrated$patient_id[i]
  draw_day <- integrated$draw_day[i]
  d <- clinical_by_patient[[pid]]

  met_known <- d[Category == "Met_Diagnosis" & ER_norm %chin% c("Positive", "Negative")][order(day)]
  prior <- met_known[day <= draw_day]
  closest_index <- if (nrow(met_known)) which.min(abs(met_known$day - draw_day)) else integer(0)

  therapy_map <- c(
    Met_Hormonal_Therapy = "Hormonal",
    Met_Chemotherapy = "Chemotherapy",
    Met_Targeted_Therapy = "Targeted"
  )
  active <- d[
    Category %chin% names(therapy_map) &
      is.finite(day) & day <= draw_day &
      (is.na(end_day) | draw_day <= end_day)
  ]
  active_types <- if (nrow(active)) {
    paste(sort(unique(unname(therapy_map[active$Category]))), collapse = ";")
  } else "None documented"
  active_regimens <- if (nrow(active) && any(!is.na(active$Regimen))) {
    paste(sort(unique(as.character(na.omit(active$Regimen)))), collapse = "; ")
  } else ""

  progression_days <- sort(d[Category == "Progression_onTx" & is.finite(day), day])
  future <- progression_days[progression_days > draw_day]
  past <- progression_days[progression_days <= draw_day]

  data.table(
    sample = integrated$sample[i],
    latest_prior_met_er = if (nrow(prior)) prior$ER_norm[nrow(prior)] else "Unknown",
    latest_prior_met_er_day = if (nrow(prior)) prior$day[nrow(prior)] else NA_real_,
    closest_met_er = if (length(closest_index)) met_known$ER_norm[closest_index] else "Unknown",
    closest_met_er_day = if (length(closest_index)) met_known$day[closest_index] else NA_real_,
    active_treatment_types = active_types,
    active_regimens = active_regimens,
    days_to_next_progression = if (length(future)) future[1L] - draw_day else NA_real_,
    days_since_last_progression = if (length(past)) draw_day - tail(past, 1L) else NA_real_
  )
}))

integrated <- merge(integrated, draw_annotations, by = "sample", all.x = TRUE)
setorder(integrated, patient_id, draw_day, sample)

# ----------------------- Residualize Griffin features --------------------------
message("Residualizing Griffin features...")
resid_diagnostics <- list()

for (feature in feature_map$feature) {
  primary_result <- residualize_one(integrated, feature, include_tfx = TRUE)
  integrated[, (paste0(feature, "__adj_TFx_depth_CTCF")) := primary_result$adjusted]
  resid_diagnostics[[length(resid_diagnostics) + 1L]] <- primary_result$diagnostic

  technical_result <- residualize_one(integrated, feature, include_tfx = FALSE)
  integrated[, (paste0(feature, "__adj_depth_CTCF")) := technical_result$adjusted]
  resid_diagnostics[[length(resid_diagnostics) + 1L]] <- technical_result$diagnostic
}

resid_diagnostics <- rbindlist(resid_diagnostics, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
fwrite(resid_diagnostics, file.path(OUTDIR, "Griffin_residualization_diagnostics.tsv"), sep = "\t")

# ----------------------- Select longitudinal discovery set --------------------
draw_counts <- integrated[, .N, by = patient_id]
setnames(draw_counts, "N", "n_draws")
fwrite(draw_counts[order(-n_draws, patient_id)], file.path(OUTDIR, "Patient_draw_counts.tsv"), sep = "\t")

eligible_patients <- draw_counts[n_draws >= MIN_DRAWS_PER_PATIENT, patient_id]
discovery <- integrated[patient_id %chin% eligible_patients]

# MEFISTO requires a non-missing temporal covariate. Keep time-from-first-draw
# for every eligible sample; report any missing time-from-metastatic-diagnosis.
discovery[, time_years_from_first_draw := days_from_first_draw / 365.25]
discovery[, time_years_from_first_met := days_from_first_met / 365.25]
discovery[, time_years_from_earliest_known_met_er := days_from_earliest_known_met_er / 365.25]

missing_met_time <- discovery[!is.finite(time_years_from_first_met), .(sample, patient_id)]
if (nrow(missing_met_time)) {
  fwrite(missing_met_time, file.path(OUTDIR, "Samples_missing_time_from_first_met.tsv"), sep = "\t")
}

# ---------------------- Prepare longitudinal CNV view -------------------------
message("Preparing targeted CNV view for the 29 non-CTCF Griffin TF genes...")
cnv_result <- prepare_cnv_tfbs_genes(cnv, discovery, OUTDIR)
cnv_long <- cnv_result$long
discovery[, cnv_available := sample %chin% cnv_result$available_samples]

# ----------------------------- Metadata output --------------------------------
metadata_cols <- c(
  "sample", "patient_id", "draw_order", "draw_day",
  "first_met_day", "days_from_first_draw", "days_from_first_met",
  "time_years_from_first_draw", "time_years_from_first_met",
  "time_years_from_earliest_known_met_er",
  "primary_er", "primary_er_day",
  "earliest_met_er", "earliest_met_er_day", "earliest_met_tissue",
  "latest_prior_met_er", "latest_prior_met_er_day",
  "closest_met_er", "closest_met_er_day",
  "met_er_changed", "met_er_sequence",
  "active_treatment_types", "active_regimens",
  "days_to_next_progression", "days_since_last_progression",
  "Mean_coverage", "Tumor_Fraction", "Ploidy",
  "CTCF_mean_coverage", "CTCF_central_coverage", "CTCF_amplitude",
  "cnv_available"
)
metadata_cols <- intersect(metadata_cols, names(discovery))
metadata <- discovery[, ..metadata_cols]
setnames(metadata, "patient_id", "group")
setorder(metadata, group, draw_day, sample)

fwrite(metadata, file.path(OUTDIR, "MEFISTO_sample_metadata.tsv"), sep = "\t")

# ------------------------------ Long inputs -----------------------------------
message("Creating MEFISTO long-format matrices...")
primary_long <- make_mefisto_long(discovery, feature_map, "primary_tfx_adjusted", cnv_long)
raw_long <- make_mefisto_long(discovery, feature_map, "raw", cnv_long)
technical_long <- make_mefisto_long(discovery, feature_map, "technical_adjusted", cnv_long)

fwrite(
  primary_long,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "MEFISTO_long_residualized_primary.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
fwrite(
  raw_long,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "MEFISTO_long_raw_Griffin_sensitivity.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
fwrite(
  technical_long,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "MEFISTO_long_technical_adjusted_sensitivity.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

# Save an audit table with clinical timing and unadjusted biological features.
audit_cols <- unique(c(
  metadata_cols,
  TUMOR_FRAGMENTATION_FEATURES,
  feature_map$feature,
  paste0(feature_map$feature, "__adj_TFx_depth_CTCF"),
  paste0(feature_map$feature, "__adj_depth_CTCF")
))
audit_cols <- intersect(audit_cols, names(discovery))
fwrite(
  discovery[, ..audit_cols],
  file.path(OUTDIR, "Integrated_longitudinal_MEFISTO_audit_table.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

# ------------------------------- Final QC -------------------------------------
view_feature_counts <- unique(primary_long[, .(view, feature)])[, .N, by = view]
setnames(view_feature_counts, "N", "n_features")
fwrite(view_feature_counts, file.path(OUTDIR, "MEFISTO_view_feature_counts.tsv"), sep = "\t")

qc_summary <- data.table(
  metric = c(
    "Metasheet samples",
    "Griffin samples",
    "Clinical blood-draw samples",
    "CNV samples matching known AURORA samples",
    "Integrated molecular samples",
    "Integrated patients",
    paste0("Patients with >=", MIN_DRAWS_PER_PATIENT, " draws"),
    paste0("Samples from patients with >=", MIN_DRAWS_PER_PATIENT, " draws"),
    "Samples missing time from first metastatic diagnosis",
    "Discovery samples with CNV",
    "Requested non-CTCF Griffin TF genes for CNV",
    "Requested TF genes found in CNV matrix",
    "Requested TF genes retained after targeted QC",
    "Primary long rows",
    "Raw sensitivity long rows",
    "Technical-adjusted sensitivity long rows"
  ),
  value = c(
    uniqueN(meta$sample),
    uniqueN(griffin$sample),
    uniqueN(blood$sample),
    uniqueN(cnv_sample_ids),
    uniqueN(integrated$sample),
    uniqueN(integrated$patient_id),
    uniqueN(discovery$patient_id),
    uniqueN(discovery$sample),
    nrow(missing_met_time),
    length(cnv_result$available_samples),
    cnv_result$n_requested_genes,
    cnv_result$n_found_genes,
    cnv_result$n_selected_genes,
    nrow(primary_long),
    nrow(raw_long),
    nrow(technical_long)
  )
)
fwrite(qc_summary, file.path(OUTDIR, "Input_preparation_QC_summary.tsv"), sep = "\t")

# Confirm every metadata sample appears in each long file.
for (nm in c("primary_long", "raw_long", "technical_long")) {
  x <- get(nm)
  missing_samples <- setdiff(metadata$sample, unique(x$sample))
  if (length(missing_samples)) {
    fwrite(
      data.table(sample = missing_samples),
      file.path(OUTDIR, paste0("WARNING_samples_absent_from_", nm, ".tsv")),
      sep = "\t"
    )
  }
}

sink(file.path(OUTDIR, "input_preparation_sessionInfo.txt"))
print(sessionInfo())
sink()

message("\nInput preparation completed successfully.")
message("Output directory: ", normalizePath(OUTDIR, mustWork = FALSE))
message("Primary MEFISTO input: MEFISTO_long_residualized_primary.tsv")
message("CNV mapping: CNV_selected_TFBS_gene_mapping.tsv")
message("Metadata: MEFISTO_sample_metadata.tsv")
message("Review Input_preparation_QC_summary.tsv before model training.")
```
